newsitem.title: UK: UK Conservative Clarke won't serve under Hague.
newsitem.headline: UK Conservative Clarke won't serve under Hague.

text.p: Defeated British Conservative leadership challenger Kenneth Clarke said on Thursday he would not serve in the "shadow" cabinet of new party leader William Hague.
Clarke, the former finance minister, told reporters he would play an active role in politics from the Conservative back benches and would be "an unstinting supporter" of Hague.
Hague, a former Welsh secretary, easily won the leadership ballot of Conservative members of parliament, collecting 92 votes against 70 for Clarke.
